$comment: PURPOSE AND SHAPE: One note per top-level CIS Control (18 of them), the parent tier above the safeguards emitted by the companion cis-controls-v8-flat recipe. PROPERTIES: title (the control's short name), control (the control number, and the join key the safeguard notes point back at via their own control property), and level (a literal 'control' discriminator, because both tiers come from the same sheet and may land in one vault). curie is emitted automatically from source.ontology plus the identifier and is deliberately not declared here. BODY: the source's Description column is the control's normative statement (109 to 497 characters across the 18 rows) and is projected as a single '## Control' section. It was previously a frontmatter value; moving it is the point of this revision. PROPERTIES-VS-BODY RATIONALE: a multi-sentence normative paragraph in YAML is unreadable in Obsidian's property panel, awkward to escape, and invisible to body search; identity and short discriminators are the opposite and stay in frontmatter where Bases can tabulate them and the Tier 2 projection can index them. No H1 is emitted: Obsidian already renders the note title, so a heading that repeats the identifier or the title is noise. SOURCE NOTE: on the control rows the CIS Control cell is inconsistently typed — some are numbers, some are strings with a trailing space ('1 ') — hence the trim filter in both the layout template and the managed property; without it the filename would keep the trailing space. RIGHTS — RESTRICTED: CIS Controls v8.1.2 is published under Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International, and its workbook stays local-only under the gitignored Frameworks/ corpus. This recipe is a method — column names, templates, and section headings, containing no CIS content — so the recipe file itself may be committed. Generated notes, sample output, screenshots showing CIS content, and any excerpt of CIS Description or Title text MUST NOT be committed or published. Corpus provenance and rights posture: https://cybersader.github.io/crosswalker/reference/framework-corpus/. KNOWN GAP 1 — the control-to-child-safeguards relationship is not emitted at all. The children are separate rows in the same sheet, and a flat file layout with no row predicate and no cross-recipe relationship projection cannot gather them; target.enrichment children lists work within one import batch, and these two tiers are two separate imports. Emitting a guessed link set would be worse than emitting none. KNOWN GAP 2 — the workbook keeps control rows and safeguard rows in ONE sheet, distinguished only by whether CIS Safeguard is blank, and the grammar has no row predicate (spec/recipe.schema.json declares no filter/where/only_if key at any level; source.levels only names layout levels, it does not select rows). That is why this recipe and cis-controls-v8-flat exist as a pair, and why each must be pointed at a pre-filtered row selection: fed the whole sheet, this recipe would render all 153 safeguard rows as duplicate control notes and collide on filename.
